name: trendyol-mcp
description: Trendyol (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, set_inventory, end_listing, list_orders. Every to

platform_mcp_trendyol_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TRENDYOL_API_KEY
platform_mcp_trendyol_api_key.description: API KEY from Seller Center > Hesap Bilgilerim / Account Information > Entegrasyon Bilgileri / Integration Information (visible to the master/admin user only; PROD and STAGE differ); HTTP Basic username.

platform_mcp_trendyol_api_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TRENDYOL_API_SECRET
platform_mcp_trendyol_api_secret.description: API SECRET KEY from the same page; HTTP Basic password.

platform_mcp_trendyol_seller_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TRENDYOL_SELLER_ID
platform_mcp_trendyol_seller_id.description: Your Trendyol seller (supplier) ID from the same Integration Information page; used in every path.

platform_mcp_trendyol_user_agent.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TRENDYOL_USER_AGENT
platform_mcp_trendyol_user_agent.description: Mandatory User-Agent (requests without it get 403): '<sellerId> - SelfIntegration' for your own software, or '<sellerId> - <IntegratorName>' (alphanumeric, max 30 characters) when an integrator company runs it, e.g. '1234 - SelfIntegration'.

platform_mcp_trendyol_api_host.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TRENDYOL_API_HOST
platform_mcp_trendyol_api_host.description: apigw.trendyol.com (PROD) or stageapigw.trendyol.com (STAGE, IP-authorised test environment).

tools.name: me
tools.description: getSuppliersAddresses returns your shipment/return/invoice addresses ({supplierAddresses[], defaultShipmentAddress...}) — used as the credential check.

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: updatePriceAndInventory {items: [{barcode, salePrice, listPrice, quantity}]} changes the LIVE sale price and/or sellable stock of an approved product; `listing_id` is the product barcode. listPrice (the crossed-out original price) is sent equal to salePrice, so no discount is displayed. Asynchronous: raw.batchRequestId → getBatchRequestResult. Re-sending an identical body within 15 minutes is rejected. Titles/descriptions go through product update services, not here.

tools.name: set_inventory
tools.description: updatePriceAndInventory {items: [{barcode, quantity}]} sets the sellable stock (max 20,000). `sku` must be the product BARCODE Trendyol knows it by. Asynchronous batch (raw.batchRequestId).

tools.name: end_listing
tools.description: archiveProducts {items: [{barcode, archived: true}]} archives the product: it becomes invisible on Trendyol but is not deleted (reversible with archived: false). `listing_id` is the barcode. Asynchronous batch.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: getShipmentPackages (v2, mandatory from 15 Oct 2026): one row per SHIPMENT PACKAGE (raw.id is the package id; a split order has several packages with the same orderNumber). status: Created|Picking|Invoiced|Shipped|Cancelled|Delivered|UnDelivered|Returned|AtCollectionPoint|UnPacked|UnSupplied|Awaiting|Verified. Without a date window the endpoint returns the last week; `since` is not sent because startDate must be epoch milliseconds (GMT+3). orderDate is epoch ms; total is packageTotalPrice (net of discounts).
